description: Source code for MDIO (Management Data Input/Output) driver functions for MT7620 and MT7530 ethernet switch hardware in the Linux kernel. Implements MDIO read/write operations, link status handling, and utility functions for the ralnk MDIO driver.

methods.name: int mt7620_mii_busy_wait(struct mt7620_gsw * gsw)
methods.description: Waits until the MDIO interface is free or times out.

methods.name: u32 _mt7620_mii_write(struct mt7620_gsw * gsw,u32 phy_addr,u32 phy_register,u32 write_data)
methods.description: Performs a low-level write to a PHY register via MDIO.

methods.name: u32 _mt7620_mii_read(struct mt7620_gsw * gsw,int phy_addr,int phy_reg)
methods.description: Performs a low-level read from a PHY register via MDIO.

methods.name: int mt7620_mdio_write(struct mii_bus * bus,int phy_addr,int phy_reg,u16 val)
methods.description: High-level MDIO write operation using the mii_bus interface.

methods.name: int mt7620_mdio_read(struct mii_bus * bus,int phy_addr,int phy_reg)
methods.description: High-level MDIO read operation using the mii_bus interface.

methods.name: void mt7530_mdio_w32(struct mt7620_gsw * gsw,u32 reg,u32 val)
methods.description: Writes a 32-bit value to a specified register on MT7530 via MDIO.

methods.name: u32 mt7530_mdio_r32(struct mt7620_gsw * gsw,u32 reg)
methods.description: Reads a 32-bit value from a specified register on MT7530 via MDIO.

methods.name: unsigned char * fe_speed_str(int speed)
methods.description: Converts speed value to string representation.

methods.name: int mt7620_has_carrier(struct fe_priv * priv)
methods.description: Checks whether any port on the MT7620 switch has carrier detected.

methods.name: void mt7620_handle_carrier(struct fe_priv * priv)
methods.description: Updates network device carrier status based on switch port states.

methods.name: void mt7620_print_link_state(struct fe_priv * priv,int port,int link,int speed,int duplex)
methods.description: Prints link status information for a given port.

methods.name: void mt7620_mdio_link_adjust(struct fe_priv * priv,int port)
methods.description: Adjusts link state and carrier based on PHY status.
